scope: Typed single-Boolean native index equality and safe query hints; original predicate and table order retained

checks.command: cargo test --locked -p tablecraft-ace -p tablecraft-query -p tablecraft-access --test boolean_indexes --test retrieval --test boolean_selection
cargo clippy --locked -p tablecraft-ace -p tablecraft-access -p tablecraft-query --lib --test boolean_indexes --test boolean_selection --test retrieval -- -D warnings

limitations: All or exact Boolean equality only; no range, NULL or numeric/Text coercion hints
Selected malformed or unsupported indexes fail without sequential fallback
